title: Maximum Number of Balloons
summary: Given a string text, determine the maximum number of instances of the word "balloon" that can be formed using the characters from text, with each character in text used at most once.
statement: Given a string text, determine the maximum number of instances of the word "balloon" that can be formed using the characters from text, with each character in text used at most once.
constraints: Each character occurrence may be used once.
The word balloon needs two l characters and two o characters.
hints: Count every character in the text.
A copy consumes one b, one a, two l, two o, and one n.
Divide the l and o counts by two and take the minimum requirement capacity.
The scarcest required character capacity exactly limits the number of disjoint copies.
editorial: The scarcest required character capacity exactly limits the number of disjoint copies.

tests.explanation: The letters can form balloon once.
The available counts form balloon twice.
